requirements.name: ProductCommerceCard

missingBehavior.requirement: Do not render an addressable commerce card without canonical product identity.
Omit the SKU element without inventing a label or deriving identity.
Do not substitute a fixture or catalogue alias for the customer-facing name.
Keep the product identifiable but remove purchase affordance and present a non-priced unavailable treatment.
Do not format or infer a currency; remove purchase affordance with the price.
Use the neutral unavailable presentation and do not infer availability from quantity or price.
Disable the purchase action without deriving purchasability from any other field.
Omit quantity controls that require a minimum and leave quantity choice to the owning host.
Do not expose an unconstrained quantity control when the maximum is absent.
Do not assume a step; omit the local quantity control.
Do not render the canonical card view without its product identity.
Omit series when the canonical card view does not provide it.
Do not substitute fixture identity for a missing card product name.
Omit an unavailable alias without deriving one from product identity.
Render the locked unavailable treatment rather than infer stock.
Render only the projected OPENLAB state; never substitute record availability or verification language.
Omit the Strength metric rather than substitute generic product metadata.
Omit the Servings metric rather than substitute generic product metadata.
Omit Purity unless the canonical card view supplies the product-specific display.
Remove purchase affordance when the card price amount is unavailable.
Do not format the card price without its projected currency.
Disable the quantity control when the minimum is unresolved.
Disable the quantity control when the maximum is unresolved.
Do not assume a quantity increment.
Do not invent or persist a local default quantity.
Preserve the authored media region as intentionally unpopulated without substituting another product render.

variants.requirement: Support repeated product discovery without changing field ownership or inventing missing commerce truth.
Support a related-product context while preserving the same identity and commerce reference obligations.
Support single-product emphasis without gaining additional runtime fields or mutation authority.

stateObligations.requirement: Expose the runtime-projected identity, price, availability, and purchasability without local derivation.
Keep identity readable, remove purchase affordance, and avoid optimistic stock or price presentation.
Show the purchase action as unavailable and preserve a programmatic explanation supplied by the host.
Retain coherent structure without substituting unregistered media.

responsiveObligations.requirement: Permit media, facts, status, price, and action to coexist without changing reading order.
Reflow to one product decision at a time with identity and status before the purchase action.
Wrap customer names and localized price output without collision, clipping, or action displacement.

accessibilityObligations.requirement: Expose one coherent product group with an unambiguous accessible name.
Keep focus order aligned with identity, supporting link, quantity if present, and purchase action.
Communicate availability and disabled action state with text or semantics in addition to color.
Treat the registered product media as informative or decorative consistently with the host context.

forbiddenBehaviors: Do not format amountMinor without the referenced currency.
Do not infer availability or purchasability from price, media, quantity, or historical fixtures.
Do not place publication class, provenance, source labels, generic form, or record availability in ProductCommerceCard metric slots.
The ProductCommerceCard metric row is limited to projected Strength, Servings, and Purity fields.
Do not perform commerce mutation from the component.
Do not branch presentation by provider identity.

requirements.name: Shipping choice
requirements.componentOwner: OLUK Design System / checkout choice surfaces

missingBehavior.requirement: Do not render or select a shipping option without runtime identity.
Do not invent a customer label for an unidentified choice.
Keep the option non-selectable and do not infer a free or estimated amount.
Do not format the amount or allow selection without its currency.
Treat eligibility as unresolved; do not infer it from the option's presence.
Do not create a local default selection or continue with an assumed option.

variants.requirement: Present the sole runtime option without implying that Design selected it.
Present mutually exclusive runtime choices with stable option identity.

stateObligations.requirement: Expose eligible choices and the runtime-projected selection.
Retain the option label when safe, block selection, and avoid a fabricated amount.
Block continuation that depends on a shipping choice until the host supplies resolved data.

responsiveObligations.requirement: Keep label, amount, eligibility explanation, and selection control associated per option.
Stack option content without separating the control from its label or amount.
Allow labels and formatted amounts to wrap without overlap or loss of selection affordance.

accessibilityObligations.requirement: Expose the shipping choices as one programmatically named selection group.
Expose the selected state through native or equivalent programmatic semantics.
Associate an unavailable option with its runtime-supplied explanation when one is provided.
Support complete keyboard traversal and mutually exclusive selection behavior.

forbiddenBehaviors: Do not calculate shipping amounts in Design.
Do not infer eligibility or selection from array order.
Do not persist a local shipping choice as authority.
Do not continue checkout from this presentation contract.

requirements.name: OPENLAB evidence

missingBehavior.requirement: Do not expose or reconstruct an absent evidence-record identifier.
Do not merge the record with another report or infer report identity.
Do not render the record without its exact product-specific batch join.
Render only the projected customer evidence state; do not promote REPORTED to VERIFIED.
Do not expose an evidence-document action without a source-owned document identity.
Omit document type when it is not supplied by the projection.
Omit document state rather than display an internal provider status.
Omit the document action when no customer-safe destination is projected.
Omit methodology rather than substituting a generic test method.
Do not render or combine an analyte row without its source-owned identity.
Do not expose an internal analyte identifier as the customer label.
Do not merge or render an unaddressable result.
Do not infer result treatment from display content.
Do not invent a comparison operator.
Do not reconstruct a numeric result in Design; Next formats only from the owning projection.
Do not calculate or substitute a customer display value.
Omit the unit and dependent display when it is absent.

variants.requirement: Present source-projected evidence identity and availability without collapsing records or analytes.
Present one evidence record with its projected report, document, methodology, and analyte relationships intact.

stateObligations.requirement: Render only fields present in the source-owned projection and preserve record boundaries.
Identify missing optional evidence presentation without implying a failed or passed result.
Use a neutral unavailable presentation and expose no inferred evidence claim.

responsiveObligations.requirement: Keep report, batch when present, methodology, documents, and analytes within the same record boundary.
Reflow records and analytes without converting relationships into an ambiguous flat list.
Support long methodology and multiple analytes without clipping, horizontal page overflow, or detached units.

accessibilityObligations.requirement: Expose each evidence record and analyte collection with navigable semantic structure.
Give each available evidence-document action a purpose that distinguishes its record.
Do not rely on color alone to communicate result or availability presentation.
Preserve report context before methodology, documents, and analytes in visual and programmatic order.

forbiddenBehaviors: Do not infer evidence, aggregate reports, or combine analytes in Design.
Do not calculate or reformat analyte display values.
Do not substitute product, batch, report, document, or analyte identity.
Do not encode source wire types, allowed values, defaults, or thresholds in this ledger.

requirements.name: Order status
requirements.componentOwner: OLUK Design System / post-purchase status surfaces

missingBehavior.requirement: Do not infer or reconstruct prior cart progression on a post-purchase status surface.
Do not infer or reconstruct prior checkout progression on a post-purchase status surface.
Present unresolved order status without converting payment or route context into an order state.
Do not render a customer order-status record without its public order identity.
Present payment status as unresolved and do not derive it from order state.

variants.requirement: Support the immediate post-checkout status surface without asserting finality beyond runtime fields.
Support the order-received context using the same public order identity and independent status refs.
Support later status retrieval without replaying or locally advancing lifecycle state.

stateObligations.requirement: Render lifecycle order state and payment state as separate runtime-owned facts.
Use a neutral unresolved presentation without asserting success, failure, or cancellation.
Suppress the order record and defer recovery or lookup behavior to the runtime owner.

responsiveObligations.requirement: Keep public order identity, order state, payment state, and any host actions in a clear hierarchy.
Preserve public order identity before statuses and actions in a single-column reading order.
Allow runtime-projected customer-safe status content to wrap without clipping or action overlap.

accessibilityObligations.requirement: Provide an ordered heading structure that identifies the order-status region.
Permit host-controlled announcement when a displayed status changes without forcing unsolicited repeated announcements.
Distinguish order and payment status through explicit labels and semantics, not color alone.
Keep any runtime-supplied action purpose explicit and associated with the public order identity.

forbiddenBehaviors: Do not derive order state from payment state or payment state from order state.
Do not locally advance, retry, or persist lifecycle state.
Do not expose provider identity or provider-specific status language.
Do not treat completion, received, or revisit presentation as payment authority.
